remarks: P003 placed the 33% between-group reduction in death risk in rate_I. The value is a relative reduction, not an arm-specific rate; the record retained its meaning in text but used an incompatible field.
The 3-year DFS absolute-difference result was a separate prediction. No separate reference match was retained because the reference grouped it with the existing DFS CU.
The node-positive multivariable DFS result was represented separately in the prediction but had no separate CU in the reference representation.

The node-negative result and interaction context had no separate match in the reference representation; the retained classification is an unmatched prediction, not proof that the clinical statement was absent.
